atlas: CerebrA, Mindboggle-101 labels registered to MNI-ICBM2009c and corrected by hand
licence_note: The CerebrA repository is CC0 1.0 (datacite.yml and LICENSE). Its labels derive from Mindboggle-101, which NITRC lists as CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; SYNAPTICA follows the stricter of the two, which it allows (NC licences are accepted).
citation: Manera A. L., Dadar M., Fonov V., Collins D. L. 2020, CerebrA, registration and manual label correction of Mindboggle-101 atlas for MNI-ICBM152 template, Scientific Data 7:237, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-0557-9; Klein A., Tourville J. 2012, 101 labeled brain images and a consistent human cortical labeling protocol, Frontiers in Neuroscience 6:171, https://doi.org/10.3389/fnins.2012.00171
derived: Only the structures with at least half of their voxels outside Julich-Brain, and only those voxels (layers.py); compact indices per structure and side; centred like the Julich-Brain label volume (same grid). Changes made by SYNAPTICA. Not combined with any Julich-Brain file: the viewer only shows one under the other.
